facts.fact: In UMANG, the National Pension System (NPS) department's Protean CRA section has 'Email Statement', which emails the transaction statement for the past 9 financial years of Tier 1 and Tier 2 accounts
facts.quote: Email Statement Subscribers can request for transaction statement over email for past 9 financial years of Tier 1 and Tier 2 accounts.

facts.fact: For KFintech CRA subscribers, the UMANG NPS service 'Email Transaction Statement' does the same after login with PRAN and password
facts.quote: Email Transaction Statement Subscribers can request for transaction statement over email for past 9 financial years of Tier 1 and Tier 2 accounts by entering PRAN and Password for authentication

behaviour: Gives the deep link to the NPS transaction-statement service in UMANG (National Pension System (NPS) department, under the subscriber's CRA) from the catalogue; if it is not listed, points to the official NPS/CRA channel. Does not fetch the statement itself.
fail_if: Invents a link or service; points to a non-official site; asks for the PRAN password.
summary: Added from UMANG NPS page: 'Email Statement' (Protean CRA) and 'Email Transaction Statement' (KFintech CRA, PRAN + password), past 9 financial years, Tier 1 and 2.
